You know, I was just thinking about how unpredictable spring weather can be - one day it's sunny, the next it's pouring rain. Makes planning anything outdoors quite the adventure!

Now, about those French kings: Louis XV was the great-grandson of Louis XIV. Louis XIV (the Sun King) was succeeded by his great-grandson because his son and eldest grandson had both died before him. So Louis XV inherited the throne in 1715 when he was only five years old, with Philippe d'Orléans serving as regent during his minority.

Answer: Louis XV was the great-grandson of Louis XIV.

Confidence: 100%
